newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ballarat Brewing says take no action.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ballarat Brewing says take no action.

text.p: Pub operator Ballarat Brewing Ltd said on Wednesday that it was advising shareholders to take no action on a takeover offer by Foster's Brewing Group Ltd subsidiary Carlton and United Breweries (CUB).

Ballarat said its board would meet as soon as possible to consider the offer of A$2.50 a share. The offer, which is five cents higher than an existing hostile bid by a unit of GPG Plc, values the company at A$67.74 million.
Foster's already holds 41.6 percent of Ballarat. Ballarat shares were trading at A$2.51 in Wednesday afternoon trading.
